text: Owner decisions 2026-10-23 on ADR 0026 (all recommended): (1) promotion is a checked SpeechPromotion overlay in document, outside StoryModel, status WorldKnowledgeInferred; (2) contestation from recall-blind source artifacts; (3) deception is a Contestation record (Deception|Retraction|Correction) on the utterance; (4) unattributed speakers may promote. ADR accepted at claude/s4-promotion; docs review pending.
